## 0. Setup
```{r setup, message=FALSE}
# ---- Clear the environment ----
rm(list=ls())

# ---- Load libraries ----
library(dplyr)
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(scales)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(writexl)
library(microshades)

# ---- File paths ----
current_path <- dirname(rstudioapi::getActiveDocumentContext()$path)
input_path   <- file.path(current_path, "../data/processed/s18_microbial/otu_tables")
output_path  <- file.path(current_path, "../output/community_composition")
```

## 1. Load & tidy phyloseq data
```{r}
abund_m <- data.matrix(
  read.csv(file.path(input_path,"s18_otu_qc_relabund_table.csv"), row.names = 1) # Count table
  )
tax_m <- as.matrix(
  read.csv(file.path(input_path,"s18_otu_qc_tax_table.csv"),   row.names = 1) # Taxonomy table
  )
meta <- read.csv(file.path(input_path,"s18_otu_qc_sample_data.csv"), row.names = 1) # Sample data

# ---- Create phyloseq object ----
ps_rel <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(abund_m, taxa_are_rows = T), 
  tax_table(tax_m),
  sample_data(meta))
ps_rel

# ---- Variable lists ----
dm     <- c("09 Jul","16 Jul","23 Jul","30 Jul","06 Aug")
stage  <- c("Pre","Storm","Post")
stage2 <- c("Pre","Storm", "Post1w", "Post2w")
site   <- c("P1","P2","P3","P4","P5","P6","P7","P8","P9","P10","OM2")
region <- c("Kahawai","Mauka","Makai")
pchem  <- c("S_Temp_C","S_Salinity_ppt","S_DO_mgL","S_pH","Turb_FAU") # physicochemical variable column names
nuts   <- c("NO3_uM","NO2_uM","NH3_uM","PO4_uM","SiO2_uM") # Nutrient variable column names

# ---- Format levels ----
ps_rel@sam_data$DM     <- factor(ps_rel@sam_data$DM, levels = dm)
ps_rel@sam_data$Stage  <- factor(ps_rel@sam_data$Stage, levels = stage)
ps_rel@sam_data$Stage2 <- factor(ps_rel@sam_data$Stage2, levels = stage2)
ps_rel@sam_data$Site   <- factor(ps_rel@sam_data$Site, levels = site)
ps_rel@sam_data$Region <- factor(ps_rel@sam_data$Region, levels = region)
```

## 2. Relative abundnce summary tables
Calculates descriptive relative abundance metrics (mean and standard deviations) between sampling dates and storm stages.
```{r}
# Write tabulation function
tab_rank <- function(rank) {
  ps_glom <- tax_glom(ps_rel, taxrank = rank, NArm = TRUE) # Conglomerate
  tt <- (as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_glom))) # save tax table
  df <- psmelt(ps_glom) # Melt to data frame
  
  # Tabulate total
  tab_all <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!sym(rank)) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Total_Sum = number((sum(Abundance)/sum(df$Abundance))*100,0.001), # Calculate sum percentage
      .groups = "drop")
  
  # Tabulate by storm stage
  tab_stage <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!sym(rank), Stage) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Mean = number(mean(Abundance * 100), 0.01), # Calculate mean
      SD   = number(sd(Abundance * 100), 0.01), # Calculate sd
      .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = Stage, 
    values_from = c(Mean, SD),
    names_glue  = "{Stage} {.value}") %>%
  dplyr::select(1,2,5,3,6,4,7)   # Reorder 
  
  # Tabulate by date
  tab_date <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!sym(rank), DM) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Mean = number(mean(Abundance * 100), 0.01), # Calculate mean
      SD   = number(sd(Abundance * 100), 0.01), # Calculate sd
      .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = DM, 
    values_from = c(Mean, SD),
    names_glue  = "{DM} {.value}") %>%
  dplyr::select(1,2,7,3,8,4,9,5,10,6,11)   # Reorder 
  
  # Format output
  combined <- list(tab_all, tab_stage, tab_date) %>% purrr::reduce(~ left_join(.x, .y, by = rank))
  out <- tt %>% dplyr::select(where(~ !all(is.na(.x)))) %>% left_join(combined, by = rank)
  colnames(out) <- gsub("[[:space:]\\.]", "_", colnames(out))
  
  # Export CSV file
  filename <- paste0("s18_tax_summary_", which(colnames(tt) == rank), "_", rank, ".csv")  # Build file name
  write.csv(out, file.path(output_path, filename), row.names = FALSE) # Save to CSV
  return(out)
}

# Generate a named list of tab_rank() outputs
tax_ranks = colnames(tax_table(ps_rel))
tabs <- lapply(tax_ranks, function(r) tab_rank(rank = r))
names(tabs) <- tax_ranks   # sheet names

# Write all to Excel
write_xlsx(tabs, path = file.path(output_path, "s18_tax_summary.xlsx"))
```

## Customized tabulations
Calculates descriptive relative abundance metrics for specific groups with exclusions or additional grouping factors.
```{r}
# Write customized tabulation function
tab_taxa <- function(filter, exclude, add_Grouping = NULL) {
  tt <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rel)) # save tax table
  
  # Detect which columns to filter on
  filter_rank <- names(tt)[ sapply(tt, function(col) any(col %in% filter)) ]
  if (is.null(exclude)) {
    keep_taxa <- rownames(tt)[ tt[[filter_rank]] %in% filter ]
  } else {
    exclude_rank <- names(tt)[ sapply(tt, function(col) any(col %in% exclude)) ]
    keep_taxa <- rownames(tt)[ tt[[filter_rank]] %in% filter & !(tt[[exclude_rank]] %in% exclude) ]
  }
  
  # Prune
  ps_filt <- prune_taxa(keep_taxa, ps_rel)
  ps_filt_glom <- tax_glom(ps_filt, taxrank = filter_rank, NArm = TRUE)
  df <- psmelt(ps_filt_glom)
  
  # Tabulate by storm stage
  tab_stage <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!sym(filter_rank), Stage, !!!if (!is.null(add_Grouping)) syms(add_Grouping) else NULL) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Mean_perc = number(mean(Abundance * 100), 0.01), # Calculate mean
      SD_perc   = number(sd(Abundance * 100), 0.01), # Calculate sd
      Min_perc  = number(min(Abundance * 100), 0.01), # Calculate minimum
      Max_perc  = number(max(Abundance * 100), 0.01), # Calculate maximum
      .groups = "drop"
    )  %>% dplyr::rename(Group = Stage)
  
  # Tabulate by date
  tab_date <- df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!sym(filter_rank), DM, !!!if (!is.null(add_Grouping)) syms(add_Grouping) else NULL) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      Mean_perc = number(mean(Abundance * 100), 0.01), # Calculate mean
      SD_perc   = number(sd(Abundance * 100), 0.01), # Calculate sd
      Min_perc  = number(min(Abundance * 100), 0.01), # Calculate minimum
      Max_perc  = number(max(Abundance * 100), 0.01), # Calculate maximum
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% dplyr::rename(Group = DM)
  
  # Output
  out <- rbind(tab_stage, tab_date)
  return(out)
}

# Explore other groups
tab_taxa(filter = "Dinophyceae", exclude = c())
```


## Stacked barplot
```{r}
mdf <- prep_mdf(ps_rel, subgroup_level = "Genus") # Prepare melted dataframe (mdf)

# Create a color object
color_ps <- create_color_dfs(mdf, group_level = "Division", 
                             subgroup_level = "Genus", 
                             cvd = F,
                             selected_groups = 
                               c("Stramenopiles","Alveolata","Chlorophyta","Cryptophyta")) 
mdf_ps <- color_ps$mdf # Extract data
mdf_ps$Sample <- mdf_ps$Site # Use shorter sample name
cdf_ps <- color_ps$cdf # Extract data


# Order sites by region
site_order <- c("P3","P4","P7","P5",      # Kahawai
                "P6","P2","P1","P10",     # Mauka
                "P8","P9","OM2")          # Makai

mdf_ps$Sample <- factor(as.character(mdf_ps$Sample), levels = site_order)

# Custom legend
leg <- custom_legend(
  mdf_ps,
  cdf_ps,
  group_level = "Division",
  subgroup_level = "Genus",
  x = "Sample",
  y = "Abundance",
  legend_key_size = 0.25,
  legend_text_size = 9,
  legend_orientation = "vertical"
)

# Plot
barplot <- suppressWarnings(plot_microshades(mdf_ps, cdf_ps, group_label = "Division Genus")) + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = expansion(0)) +
  facet_grid(~ DM, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  xlab("Site") + ylab("Relative Abundance") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size= 6),
        legend.position = "none",
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        panel.background  = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        strip.text = element_text(color = "black", face = "bold")
        )

barplot$layers[[1]]$aes_params$colour    <- "grey90"
barplot$layers[[1]]$aes_params$linewidth <- 0.05
barplot$layers[[1]]$aes_params$width     <- 1
(barplot <- ggarrange(barplot, leg, widths = c(4,1)))

# Save to file
ggsave(file.path(output_path,"s18_stacked_barplot.pdf"), barplot,
        device = "pdf", width = 9, height = 4, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```
**Figure S4: Relative abundance of bacterioplankton communities in Heʻeia Fishpond before, during, and after Tropical Storm Wali.** Relative abundances were calculated from proportional 16S rRNA gene amplicon data. Stacked bars show the relative abundance of bacterial genera across all sampling sites for each sampling date. Samples are grouped by date (09 Jul, 16 Jul, 23 Jul, 30 Jul, and 06 Aug) and ordered by region within each panel. Colors correspond to genera nested within major bacterial phyla (Proteobacteria, Bacteroidota, Cyanobacteria, Verrucomicrobiota, and others). Genera with low abundance or unclassified assignments within each Division were combined into “Other.”
